name: Saffron Table Caterers
text: Saffron Table Caterers is an approved external caterer for Pune. It serves groups of 15 to 150 people, offers North Indian, South Indian and continental menus, and holds a valid FSSAI licence. Minimum order is 15 covers; orders must be placed 4 working days in advance.

name: GreenLeaf Kitchens
text: GreenLeaf Kitchens is an approved external caterer for Pune specialising in vegetarian and vegan menus. It serves groups of 10 to 60 people and holds a valid FSSAI licence. It can deliver to Baner Tech Hub and Hinjewadi within 45 minutes.

name: Deccan AV Services
text: Deccan AV Services is an approved audio-visual vendor for Pune events. It supplies projectors, microphones and live-streaming kits. Equipment requests must be placed 3 working days before the event.
